description: Legal Affairs Department - The Finance Business (Priority of Claims in a Winding up of a Finance Company) Regulations - 2019
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011. It establishes legal frameworks and compliance requirements for preferential claims in the winding up of finance companies, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions a government minister (Mangala Samaraweera), it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the primary content is regulatory rather than about government structure or personnel changes.
